verdict.rationale: Skills are shipped as plain-text SKILL.md files in the public GitHub repo ('skills/' is the source of truth, shared verbatim) and a skills-search tool exists for discovery, so a lead can in principle browse/clone the repo and read every file before and after install. However, there is no dedicated 'list contents before install' review command, and community commentary notes the install mechanism for some harnesses is 'like curl|bash but with added LLM agents,' which cuts against an explicit, structured audit workflow. Missing for 10: a built-in pre-install manifest/listing command, documented post-install file-audit tooling, and independent confirmation that installers don't execute anything before a human can inspect files.
